prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, redesign], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+5.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+7.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests across all rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Pet Selection Stage Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection stage on the pick_friend screen into a grid layout featuring pet personality tags and visual companion cards. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 64.7% with an 89s median time. Giving clear personality tags in a grid layout helps users decide faster.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Render Status and Tips: Adds interactive tips and loading progress status breakdown on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets compile. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; keeping users informed prevents anxiety and drop-offs.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Onboarding Path Time Estimate Hint: Adds an estimated time indicator to the path selection screen letting users know setup takes under 3 minutes. (why: Choose path has a mean time of 514s indicating idle drops; clear expectations encourage prompt completion.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Sync Guarantee Notice: Adds copy emphasizing that signing in protects and syncs pet adoption records across desktop sessions. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after re-authenticating; reassuring users early increases trust.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidance Hint Box: Adds explicit image criteria guidance text on the upload_photos screen to help users provide clear pet photos. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results.)
5: [finish, redesign] Interactive Home Welcome Dashboard Redesign: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a split view with quick test buttons for pet sound, desktop overlay toggle, and visibility check. (why: Finish screen median time is 395s and 3 support emails noted pet not showing on desktop or app not opening.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Centered Streamlined Sign In Layout: Updates sign_in screen to a centered layout with clean visual hierarchy. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with mean 567s; streamlining reduces cognitive friction.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Companion Path Selection Headline Refresh: Updates the headline and body of choose_path screen to emphasize fast personalized setup. (why: 23.8% drop off occurs right at choose_path screen.)
